command: ADB="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb"; SERIAL=$("$ADB" devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}'); "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop link.localclimate.app; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n link.localclimate.app/.MainActivity; sleep 2; printf 'PID='; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof link.localclimate.app; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -m1 'mResumedActivity' || true
